referencePolicy.designAnchorCredit: Original Bichon character design and visual direction by Chelsea Lee
referencePolicy.shippingRule: Files in reference/ are process records only and must not ship with the application.

rasterCanvas.alignmentRule: Keep the character centered on x=512, the top of the fluffy head near y=120, and both feet on y=1400. Do not crop fur, clothing, footwear, accessories, or handheld items.

reviewCriteria: Matches Chelsea Lee's rounded Bichon silhouette and friendly expression
Uses the same front-facing neutral pose and proportions across every outfit
Has clean transparent edges without halos or background pixels
Keeps clothing and footwear readable at phone and laptop display sizes
Contains no unintended text, logos, anatomy errors, duplicate parts, or generation artifacts

optimization.method: Approved 1024x1536 PNG masters remain unchanged. For app delivery, System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic generates 768x1152 transparent PNG character copies and a 160x160 transparent PNG logo copy in src/assets/delivery/. Vite fingerprints and ships only the delivery copies referenced by the app. Visual review of these resized copies is pending.
optimization.svgMethod: Hand-authored SVGs use compact paths, a shared 64x64 or 24x24 viewBox, and no embedded metadata.

brandLogo.productionMethod: Supplied by Chelsea Lee for the PUPCAST header; upstream production method not independently verified.
brandLogo.altGuidance: Use empty alt text in the header because the adjacent PUPCAST wordmark names the brand.

masterCharacter.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI image generation using reference/35-main-laptop-final.png as Chelsea Lee's design anchor, followed by a transparency-cleanup edit.
masterCharacter.altGuidance: Describe the upright Bichon mascot and only the clothing or accessories that communicate the current recommendation.

very-cold.displayNote: Developer accepted the visually reviewed set for the fastest path after generative cleanup could not fully standardize faint peripheral alpha. Render all outfit canvases with a consistent object-fit/object-position rule in the application.

high-uv.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI identity-preserving edits of the corresponding approved base outfits, using the Developer-approved warm high-UV look as the sunglasses reference.
high-uv.reviewNote: Sunglasses genuinely cover both eyes. Hot through cool looks include sun hats; cold and very-cold looks retain temperature-appropriate clothing instead of adding a straw hat. Chelsea Lee approved the six-look family after reviewing the repository board.

rain.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI identity-preserving edits of the corresponding approved base outfits, using the mild integrated rain look as the umbrella and jacket reference; hot and warm shoes received targeted waterproof-rubber edits.
rain.reviewNote: Each complete character wears a temperature-appropriate rain jacket, holds one coral umbrella, and wears water-resistant shoes or boots. Chelsea Lee approved the six-look family after reviewing the repository board.

snow.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI identity-preserving edits of the corresponding approved base outfits, using the approved cold snow look as an integrated-winterwear reference; cold gloves and the very-cold green neck scarf received targeted edits.
snow.reviewNote: Complete snow looks use temperature-scaled insulation, waterproof boots, and gloves; the very-cold look has a green knit neck scarf. No hot + snow artwork exists. Chelsea Lee approved the revised family after reviewing the board.

wind.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI identity-preserving edits of approved base outfits; the cool integrated wind look guided the cold-weather windwear styling.
wind.reviewNote: Six complete outfits with fitted wind-resistant outerwear appropriate to each temperature category.

heat.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI identity-preserving edits of approved base outfits, using the hot integrated heat look as a reference for the held water bottle.
heat.reviewNote: Six complete temperature-appropriate outfits, each with one water bottle held naturally by the mascot.

integratedWeatherOutfits.altGuidance: Describe only the clothing and sun-protection items actually shown in the selected complete mascot image. Communicate secondary active modifiers in interface guidance and reminders.

weatherModifiers.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI image generation using the approved master Bichon as an alignment and style reference; generated as isolated transparent clothing/accessory overlays.
weatherModifiers.subsequentReview: The Developer rejected the modifier overlays in combined mascot previews on 2026-10-05 because garments appeared pasted over the complete base outfits. Retain as process evidence only until a full-character replacement strategy is approved; do not render these layers in the finished app.
weatherModifiers.altGuidance: Do not give modifier layers separate alternative text. Describe the combined mascot outfit and only the active weather-protection details in the final mascot alternative text.

mixedPrecipitationAccessory.productionMethod: Built-in OpenAI image edit isolating the umbrella from the approved rain overlay, using the approved master Bichon as an alignment reference.
mixedPrecipitationAccessory.use: Originally intended to stack above the snow outerwear. The combined overlay composition was rejected; do not render this layer in the finished app unless a new integrated design is reviewed.
mixedPrecipitationAccessory.altGuidance: The separate overlay has empty alternative text; describe the umbrella once in the composed mascot alternative text.

weatherIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored SVGs using the approved PUPCAST palette and rounded illustration language.
weatherIcons.altGuidance: Use the normalized weather-condition label when the icon conveys information; otherwise use empty alternative text.

reminderIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored SVGs using the approved PUPCAST palette and rounded illustration language.
reminderIcons.altGuidance: Use empty alternative text because each reminder card includes a visible text label.

interfaceIcons.productionMethod: Hand-authored stroke SVGs that inherit currentColor for accessible interface use.
interfaceIcons.altGuidance: Use empty alternative text when an icon accompanies visible text. Icon-only controls require a programmatic control name rather than image alternative text. Loading and status copy is announced through the relevant live region.
